title: Mediaplane stack.yaml, version 1

version.description: The version of this file's format. Always 1.

timezone.description: The timezone the apps run in, as a tz database name such as Europe/London.

user.description: The user and group the apps run as. They must be able to write to paths.data.

data.description: The data folder for downloads and media, mounted in the apps as /data. Keep both on one filesystem inside it, so moves are instant hardlinks. An absolute path, without ":".

network.description: Where the web UIs are published.

bind.description: lan: on this host's private (RFC 1918) addresses. localhost: on 127.0.0.1 only. all: on every interface, and plan warns every time. On a cloud VM, lan needs lan_subnet.

lan_subnet.description: Your LAN, as a private (RFC 1918) IPv4 CIDR such as 192.168.1.0/24. Left out, it is detected from this host's private addresses, except on a cloud VM, where bind: lan needs it set. Mediaplane trusts it only while the web UIs are published on the LAN.

login_on_lan.description: Ask for a login from your own network too. false lets Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr skip it for any local (private) address, and qBittorrent for addresses in the LAN subnet while the web UIs are on the LAN.

admin.description: The shared admin login for the apps' web UIs, set up in each app as its slice lands: qBittorrent in Slice 3a, Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr in Slice 3b, and Jellyfin in Slice 6.

username.description: The user name of the shared admin login: 3 to 32 letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-".

password.description: The admin password, as a secret reference, at least 12 characters long. Left out, Mediaplane generates one; "mediaplane credentials" shows it.

file.description: A file that holds the secret, relative to the Mediaplane home, such as secrets/wg.key.

env.description: An environment variable that holds the secret.

media_server.description: The media server, jellyfin or plex. It runs whether or not it is listed under apps.

plex.description: Plex settings, needed when media_server is plex.

file.description: A file that holds the secret, relative to the Mediaplane home, such as secrets/wg.key.

env.description: An environment variable that holds the secret.

token.description: Your Plex token, as a secret reference. Checked to exist, but not used yet: claiming the server arrives in Slice 6.

vpn.description: The VPN that qBittorrent's traffic goes through, by way of Gluetun. Needed while apps.qbittorrent.vpn is true.

provider.description: The VPN provider, by its Gluetun name, such as mullvad.

file.description: A file that holds the secret, relative to the Mediaplane home, such as secrets/wg.key.

env.description: An environment variable that holds the secret.

private_key.description: Your WireGuard private key, as a secret reference.

addresses.description: The WireGuard address, for providers that need one, such as Mullvad: the Address line of your provider's WireGuard file, such as 10.64.0.2/32. Several go comma-separated, without spaces. Other Gluetun settings go in apps.gluetun.env.

apps.description: The apps to run, by id. Listing an app runs it, unless it sets enabled: false. The media server that media_server names runs without being listed, and no other media server can be enabled. Apps also bring along the apps they need, such as Gluetun for qBittorrent.

enabled.description: Turn the app off but keep its settings with false. Listing an app turns it on. The media server that media_server names cannot be turned off: change media_server instead.

port.description: The host port the app's web UI is published on. The port inside the container stays the same, except for qBittorrent, where both move together.
